expectations.text: Creates a Markdown design doc under docs/design/ in the project
expectations.evidence: workspace/docs/design/exportacao-de-relatorios-em-background.md exists (copied to outputs/), plus the rendered diagram at docs/design/diagrams/arquitetura-exportacao.svg (35 KB, non-trivial).

expectations.text: The document is written in Portuguese, matching the conversation language
expectations.evidence: Header, all section titles (Visão geral, Escopo e contexto, Trade-offs, Alternativas consideradas, Preocupações transversais) and prose are in Portuguese; only DSL/Mermaid keywords stay English.

expectations.text: The accepted trade-off — loss of immediate download for small exports — appears explicitly as a cost of the chosen solution
expectations.evidence: Under 'Trade-offs da solução escolhida': '✗ **O usuário perde o download imediato.** A exportação pequena, que hoje volta na hora, passa a exigir esperar um e-mail.'

expectations.text: Alternatives include the two discussed (longer synchronous timeout, external BI tool) and also 'do nothing'
expectations.evidence: The 'Alternativas consideradas' table rows are: Não fazer nada, Gerar síncrono com timeout maior, Ferramenta de BI externa, and the chosen Fila + worker — each with ✓/✗ trade-offs and outcome.

expectations.text: Cross-cutting concerns cover the platform team (shared queue) and the security team (signed links with PII)
expectations.evidence: 'Preocupações transversais' has subsections Segurança (signed link with PII, validity/retention to be ruled on), Plataforma / infraestrutura (shared RabbitMQ queue, sizing/isolation impact) and Compatibilidade.

expectations.text: A glossary is included or suggested at the beginning of the document covering terms a reviewer could stumble on (e.g. PII, BI, S3); it does NOT carry entries for universally known terms (API, HTTP, URL) nor for the document's own authoring tooling (C4, DSL, Structurizr)
expectations.evidence: '## Glossário' sits immediately after the header table with BI, CSV, gateway, job, link assinado, PII, S3, streaming, worker, XLSX — no API/HTTP/URL entries and no C4/DSL/Structurizr entries.

expectations.text: Every diagram in the doc is followed by explanatory prose (no orphan diagrams)
expectations.evidence: The container SVG (with folded DSL) is followed by a paragraph naming API, fila, worker, S3 and e-mail service; the Mermaid sequence block is followed by a paragraph walking steps 3, 4-8 and 9-11 plus a note that only the happy path is drawn.

expectations.text: No invented facts: every metric in the doc traces to the prompt (30s timeout, 12% failures, 50k/100k rows); unknowns appear as open questions or explicit blanks, never fabricated values
expectations.evidence: Only the prompt's numbers appear (30 s gateway cut, 12% above 50 mil linhas, 100 mil linhas target); Autores/Revisores are left '*a definir*' and job state, worker failure, link validity, e-mail service and verification metric are all listed under 'Perguntas em aberto' rather than filled in.

expectations.text: The overview section is at most two paragraphs and stays at solution-shape altitude: naming the core mechanism/technology is fine, but no schemas, payloads, endpoints, retry policies, or config values
expectations.evidence: '## Visão geral' is exactly two paragraphs describing enqueue-a-job / worker / object storage / signed link by e-mail; no endpoints, payloads, retry policy or config values — those details live in 'A solução' and the diagrams.
